subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order numbers to 5 (number line)
source.subtopic: Identify, read and write number symbols and number names to 5; position 1st-5th on the number line (weeks 9-10)

show.line: Five runners in a race! First, second, third, fourth, fifth. Who is first?

rounds.prompt: Tap the runner who is first.
rounds.praise: Yes! First is at the front.

rounds.prompt: Tap the car that is third in the line.
The bird is at the end of five. Is it first or fifth? Say it.
Draw five with your finger. Down, round the tummy, then a hat on top.

hints: Start at the front. First, second, third, fourth, fifth.
Point and count. The number you land on tells you the place.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the second runner.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one at the back is second!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The one at the back is fifth. Second is right behind first.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's point together. First, second. That is the second runner!

parent_line: Can say first to fifth and read the number words one to five.
